subject: Inquiry regarding the duration of observation data

messages.author: 14acf3cf1ba1a268
messages.subject: Inquiry regarding the duration of observation data
parts: "Hello. I'm facing another issue while using R-SWAT (ArcSWAT) and I would like to inquire about it. Currently, I am using code developed without a UI to run R-SWAT (ArcSWAT). I am conducting a hydrological simulation, using data from three observation points within the watershed. However, there is a slight difference in the observation dates for the three points. I have set the simulation time based on the data from the observation point with the longest period. However, an error occurs during the calculation of 'calculate 95ppu.' I am wondering if there is a requirement for the observation data to have the same duration for all three points. I look forward to your response. Thank you."

messages.author: e28329d3e25e358e
messages.subject: Re: Inquiry regarding the duration of observation data
parts: The duration of the observed data file need to be the same in all observed files (unless you use the option - userReadSwatOutput". However, the data at different points are available at different time period - to solve it - put NA in the date that there is no data in the data column. In the attached figure is an example when I calibrate for two variables, one with observed data is avaiable from 2000-01-03 and the other variable which observed data is available at 2000-01-01 with some missing values

The duration of the observed data file need to be the same in all observed files (unless you use the option - userReadSwatOutput". However, the data at different points are available at different time period - to solve it - put NA in the date that there is no data in the data column.
